pyg.reason: not needed -- no graph-native dynamics in this seam geometry

z3.reason: load_bearing: UNSAT proof that M is in the seam (f(M)=0) AND M is strictly inside the lower shell (f(M)<0) -- the seam and interior are disjoint sets

cvc5.reason: not needed -- z3 covers the UNSAT disjointness proof; cvc5 deferred

sympy.reason: load_bearing: symbolic gradient of f_O(M) = det(M^T M - I) near O(3); at M in O(3): f=0; linear approximation gives the seam tangent space

clifford.reason: load_bearing: seam as grade transition in Cl(3,0); GL/O seam: grade-0 scalar (scale) transitions from nonzero to zero; SO/U seam: imaginary grade-2 bivector activates

rustworkx.reason: load_bearing: 5-node seam graph (one node per adjacent pair seam); connected seams that share a shell; verify the seam graph is a path

xgi.reason: load_bearing: for each seam, a triple hyperedge {shell_lower, shell_upper, seam}; the seam is a 3-way object belonging to both shells simultaneously

P1_gl_o_seam_vanishes_on_o3.note: f_GL_O(M) = 0 for M in O(3) -- M is exactly on the GL/O seam

P2_gl_o_seam_positive_inside_gl.note: f_GL_O(M) > 0 for M in GL(3) not in O(3) -- not on the seam

P3_so_u_seam_vanishes_on_real_matrix.note: f_SO_U(M) = ||Im(M)||_F = 0 for real M -- M is at the SO/U seam

P4_so_u_seam_positive_for_complex.note: f_SO_U(M) > 0 for complex M in U(3) -- not on the SO/U seam

P5_u_su_seam_vanishes_on_su3.note: f_U_SU(M) = 0 for M in SU(3) -- det(M)=1 exactly

P6_u_su_seam_positive_for_nontrivial_pha.note: f_U_SU(M) >= 0; > 0 when det(M) != 1 (U(1) phase factor present)

P7_autograd_gl_o_seam_gradient_nonzero.note: Autograd computes ||grad_M f_GL_O(M)|| -- seam is differentiable

P8_su_sp_seam_vanishes_on_identity.note: f_SU_SP(I) = 0: identity embeds into both SU(3) and Sp(6) trivially

N1_z3_unsat_seam_and_interior_disjoint.note: UNSAT: f(M)=0 AND f(M)<0 is impossible -- seam and interior are disjoint

N2_seam_distinguishes_interior_from_exte.note: Seam function f=0 on O(3), f>0 on GL(3)\O(3) -- seam detects the boundary

N3_sympy_f_o_vanishes_at_identity.note: Symbolic det(M^T M - I) = 0 at M=I (identity is in O(2))

N4_perturbed_off_seam_has_positive_f.note: Perturbing M off O(3) gives f_GL_O > 0 -- seam is exactly at f=0

N5_clifford_grade0_transition_at_gl_o_se.note: Clifford grade-0 (scale): 2 inside GL, 1 on GL/O seam -- seam = scale transition

B1_seam_crossed_by_continuous_path.note: Continuous path from inside O(3) outward crosses the GL/O seam

B2_seam_gradient_nonzero_at_phi0.note: Gradient of f at the seam (Phi0 point) is well-defined

B3_xgi_triple_hyperedges_for_seams.note: 5 triple hyperedges {shell_lower, shell_upper, seam} in xgi hypergraph

B4_det_distinguishes_so3_from_o3_compone.note: f_O_SO = det(M)-1: 0 on SO(3), -2 on O(3)\SO(3) -- det is the seam function

B5_so_u_seam_transition_at_imaginary_act.note: f_SO_U = ||Im(M)||_F: 0 at boundary, grows as imaginary part activates
